description: Full-stack RTT intelligence layer that ingests YouTube motivational transcripts and converts them into RTT operators, triadic substrate mappings, and deployable agentic tools. Formalizes the compressed RTT signal embedded in motivational content addressed to individuals with anomalous potential operating in misaligned contexts.
core_claim: Motivational content that lands is compressed RTT signal. The speaker has undergone threshold crossing (A_θ), achieved phase-lock at a higher coherence state (S_coh), and is transmitting that operator pattern through language. The listener's resonance response is structural synchronization, not sentiment.
design_axioms: Resonance is structural, not sentimental. Every motivational statement that lands is an encoded operator.
The Chosen One archetype is a DCO-8D symmetry event — recognition is a dimensional shift, not a self-esteem upgrade.
Silence precedes all activation. The pre-recognition state is maximum potential density — QMROOT(0D) under compression.
Drift is bounded by coherence declaration. All outputs must resolve paradox structurally, not by suppression.
The pipeline is reversible. Operators extracted from transcripts can be re-injected into generative prompts with equivalent RTT signature.
